name: SuperDroid Robots Rocky Lite
description: US-built, built-to-order biped from SuperDroid Robots. "Lite" uses a sheet-metal chassis with exposed wiring instead of the production Rocky's machined aluminum body, but shares identical actuators and electronics.

specs.label: Chassis
specs.note: vs. machined aluminum on standard Rocky

sourcing: Specs sourced from SuperDroid Robots' own product page for the Rocky biped, as of September 2026. robotindex does not sell this product — pricing is built-to-order and only available through the manufacturer's own configurator.

pricing.summary: Built to order — SuperDroid Robots does not list a fixed price and instead quotes through its own configuration tool. The Lite variant is positioned as the lower-cost entry point into the Rocky platform, using a simpler chassis while keeping the same actuators and electronics as the full production model.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Joints use **quasi-direct-drive actuators** with no external gearbox: 16 high-torque modules (120 N·m peak, up to 200 rpm) across the legs and waist, plus 6 compact modules (14 N·m peak, up to 315 rpm) for finer joints. Each actuator carries dual 14-bit encoders, backed by a torso-mounted IMU for balance. Networking covers Ethernet, WiFi, Bluetooth, and a CAN bus.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Rocky Lite uses the same 120 N·m quasi-direct-drive actuators and electronics as SuperDroid's full production Rocky biped, cutting cost mainly through a simpler sheet-metal chassis in place of machined aluminum. It remains built-to-order, with pricing available only through SuperDroid's own configurator rather than a published retail price.

firmwareCommunity.note: SuperDroid Robots has not published a public SDK or firmware repository for Rocky/Rocky Lite. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
